record_audits.database_subject: Evaluation of the Antibacterial Activity of New Dermaseptin Derivatives against Acinetobacter baumannii.
record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (92.86%) to Dermaseptin-S4 A: 32%; L=K: 21%. Activity: active against A. baumannii (MIC 3.125 ug/ml). MBC: 6.25 ug/ml. virus: it also inhibits Zika virus (ZIKV) (EC50 0.42 ug/ml) ( Haddad et al., 2024). In vitro Toxicity: Hep-2 Cells (TC50 75.71 ug/ml). Updated 7/2024

record_audits.database_subject: Evaluation of the Antibacterial Activity of New Dermaseptin Derivatives against Acinetobacter baumannii.
record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (61.11%) to C18G K: 31%; L=A: 25%. Activity: active against A. baumannii (MIC 6.25 ug/ml). MBC: 12.5 ug/ml. Virus: it inhibited Zika virus (ZIKV) (EC50 0.82 ug/ml) ( Haddad et al., 2024). In vitro Toxicity: Hep-2 Cells (TC50 68.9 ug/ml). MOA:bacteria:A. baumannii: morphological change observed in AFM, implying membrane damage.
